title: 15″ Gear Premium 7mm Thick Straight Bong
description: The Thick Straight Bong from Gear Premium stands at 15 inches long with a 7mm thick design and an extended base for improved stability. The bong features a slender chamber and built-in ice catcher to help facilitate smoke filtration and make clearing each bowl a breath of fresh air.
